title: picklist metadata kind — runtime: resolve `picklist` → options when serving field metadata, validate writes against the resolved set, apply package-level extensions (phase 1 of objectstack#18164)
body:
Blocked-by: #19518
Path: 本地跑起来、看到 — records-forms (清单项待写, authored with the spec sub-issue) | P2

Sub-issue of objectstack#18164 (shared picklist / global value set), filed by the director seat, summon #25 (`session_012GcsUbuqFGBibkEDMRC1eE`) under ruling batch #209 item 1 · letter A · maintainer 「18164 同意」 (2026-09-21, chat). ⛔ Not a claim. Position in the road: step ②「本地跑起来、看到」, records/studio; it is taken **after** the open product P0/P1 checklist items by the road order — ⛔ not dispatched before them. The design of record is the batch #147 item 2 ruling on the parent (comment 5715762696), reproduced here only where this layer needs it.

## Scope (the runtime layer — metadata loading and the engine, `domain:engine`: `packages/metadata*`, `packages/objectql`, `packages/platform-objects`)

1. **Load** `*.picklist.ts` before objects; register the kind in the metadata registry; `picklistExtensions` from any package merge additively into the named picklist (duplicate value = refused loudly, ⛔ not last-wins).
2. **Resolve at serve time**: a select field with `picklist: name` is served with the resolved `options` (merged base + extensions, translated per the request locale through the translation face the spec sub-issue declares); an unknown picklist name is a loud load-time error naming the field and the package, ⛔ never an empty option list.
3. **Write validation** uses the resolved set at the write door (the same door that validates inline `options` today); the refusal names the picklist.
4. **hotcrm acceptance**: the reference app migrates its shared lists (`src/objects/_picklists.ts`, 17 consumers across three packages) — filed as a hotcrm card by the epic PM when this lands; ⛔ not in this PR.
5. Phase 2 (⛔ not here): per-organization overlay in `sys_metadata` with `allowOrgOverride: true` and an overlay schema that accepts new values only; Studio surfaces (the objectui sub-issue).

## Acceptance

One dogfood case (ADR-0136 D2.4): one picklist, two objects, a package extension adds a value, object A writes it, a value outside the set is refused on object B, a locale switch relabels. Engine tests pin: load order, merge, unknown-name refusal, write refusal, served shape. `check:engine-*` families green.

Dedupe words: picklist, resolved options, picklistExtensions, sys_metadata overlay, _picklists.ts.
